description: Save a new client of the connected facturo account. Only after search_clients found no match. Fill every field you know; ask the user for the address if it is missing (documents need it). A client with the same name (and street) already exists is returned instead of duplicated. For a client that only appears on one invoice, preview_invoice with a client object does this on its own.

client_name.description: Company or person name as printed on documents

country.description: Two-letter country code (AT, DE, CH, IT ...), default AT

name_line2.description: Second address line (contact person, department, c/o)

payment_terms.description: Payment terms printed for this client, e.g. 'Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen'

name: create_client
title: Kunde anlegen
